title: The truth about this percolator
text: The truth about this percolator. Visually this percolator looks virtually identical to the original Farberwares from the 1950's that were made in the USA.  The new units being sold today are manufactured in China. The base and handle are made of dense heat resistant plastic that emulates the phenolic material used in the original models. The result is a slightly lighter pot. The finish on the metal is less resilient than found on the older models and somewhat more susceptible to discoloration. This won't be an issue if you care for the pot properly and keep it clean. The brew cycle is quite fast which some people will like. The downside to a quick brewing cycle is much less yield from your coffee grinds.  It takes at least 3 standard scoops to yield 4 cups of medium strength coffee. That's about 50% less efficient than what a decent drip machine will deliver. On the upside, the quick brewing cycle doesn't overcook the coffee and yields pretty decent results. The Achilles heel on these machines appears to be the heating element. If you get a good unit you can expect 3 or 4 years out of this pot with regular use, perhaps a bit more if you're lucky. That said there seems to be a fair number of these units that suffer from premature heating element failure. The elements are either made cheaply, not big enough, or not always installed properly.  That said you'll be hard pressed to find a nicer looking retro styled pot that makes decent percolated coffee for $50. No, it's not the same as the virtually indestructible Farberware pots from the 50's and 60's but it's a pretty decent product all things considered. Purchase an inexpensive Square Trade or similar extended warranty on it for a few bucks for peace of mind and you won't have to worry if you end up with a bad one.

description: Product Description Rediscover the robust aroma and taste of percolated coffee with the FARBERWARE 2-4 Cup* Stainless Steel Electric Percolator. This premium unit produces about one cup per minute, so there’s no waiting around for delicious coffee. The automatic “keep warm” function gently warms coffee after perking, and the detachable cord makes for easy pouring and storage. *Cup equals approximately 5 oz (varies by brewing technique) For Farberware percolators: “FARBERWARE and FARBERWARE are used under license from Farberware Licensing Company, LLC Brand Story By Farberware From the Manufacturer Farberware's 1000-watt, two- to four-cup percolator quickly brews at cup-a-minute speed for coffee in no time. Once the brewing is complete, the percolator automatically switches to "keep warm" temperature. Stainless steel construction offers durability and the detachable cord makes for easy serving. Rolled edges offer safe handling as do the stay cool handle and cover knob.
